summary: issue-521-lfs-transport: rustls TLS transport for Git LFS https remotes — exploring guard-compatible complete_io driving and trust-root injection seam

rustls::Stream::read prepare_read loops internally on wants_read and could bypass the cooperative IoGuard; a manual TlsConn driving complete_io once per call propagates WouldBlock to the guard instead

Adopted manual TlsConn: one complete_io + reader().read per op, WouldBlock propagated to IoGuard; complete_io back-pressures on buffered plaintext so no plaintext is dropped (verified against vendored rustls source)

Adopted ProviderContext.tls: Option<TlsTrust> — None = lazily-loaded native roots (rustls-native-certs, once per process), Some = TlsTrust::from_pem explicit CAs; TlsTrust hides rustls types publicly; verification strength unchanged

rustls::Error::InvalidCertificate is the precise discriminator for trust failures; all other rustls/IO errors during handshake or record exchange classify as TransientIo while preserving existing Offline/Cancelled/BudgetExceeded mappings

Adopted error mapping: InvalidCertificate -> ProviderErrorKind::TlsVerification (RetryAdvice::Never, new #[non_exhaustive] variant + library_ui wire tag tls-verification per coordinator option A); other TLS errors -> TransientIo; no cert bytes/peer data/credentials in error detail

cargo check --all-targets -p synvelis-library clean; cargo test --test lfs 19/19 pass incl. MockTlsServer trusted-CA happy path, untrusted CA -> TlsVerification, native-roots reject, TLS redirect, cross-origin credential isolation, deadline during handshake

Rejected: enabling WebDAV-over-HTTPS in this slice — send() keeps rejecting https as UnsupportedCapability; TLS transport is opt-in via HttpEndpoint.tls for Git LFS only (WebDAV https release stays with issue #90)

issue-521-lfs-transport: all adopt/reject decisions fixed during implementation — manual TlsConn over rustls::Stream, ProviderContext.tls trust seam, TlsVerification typed error, WebDAV https boundary unchanged; fixture = in-process MockTlsServer with rcgen CA, no external network
